description: Splits a signal into its eight bits and builds a signal back out of eight bits, with nothing between them but the cables you patch

inputs.text: The signal being digitised, read as eight bits across -10V to +10V
A trigger here takes one new reading of the input; with nothing patched the input is read every sample
A trigger here builds one new output sample from the bits; with nothing patched the output is rebuilt every sample
Any voltage other than 0V sets that bit of the number the output is built from, and an unpatched jack leaves the bit clear

outputs.text: The number rebuilt as a voltage, -10V to +10V, and inverted, so patching each A/D jack straight across to the D/A jack in the same row gives the input back unchanged
10V while that bit of the digitised input is 0, and 0V while it is 1

notes: in both columns the jack at the top carries the least significant bit and the one at the bottom the most significant

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
